scripts.build:widget: npm run build --workspace apps/widget && node -e "const fs=require('fs');fs.cpSync('apps/widget/dist/widget.js','apps/api/dist/widget.js');fs.cpSync('apps/widget/dist/widget.js','BotNestWebsite/widget.js');console.log('[build] widget.js synced to apps/api/dist and BotNestWebsite/widget.js (the file served at https://bot-nest.com/widget.js)');"
scripts.build: npm run build:widget && npm run build --workspace apps/api
